1. Overview

KOMPSAT-5 NRB is a Normalised Radar Backscatter product derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations acquired by KOMPSAT-5, also known as Arirang-5. The Korea Aerospace Research Institute (KARI) is developing the product for assessment under the CEOS Analysis Ready Data (CEOS-ARD) framework.

This page provides an overview of the products and links to the product description, algorithm documentation and quality assessment report.

CEOS-ARD product listing: KOMPSAT-5 NRB · Status: Under Development. Final product specifications and supporting documents are pending confirmation by KARI.

2. Product description

2.1 Normalised Radar Backscatter

The NRB product concept combines geometric correction and radiometric terrain correction to support the analysis of SAR backscatter. Product-specific processing methods, backscatter conventions, image layers and metadata will be described in the documentation below.

The source mission is KOMPSAT-5 (Arirang-5), equipped with a synthetic aperture radar. The NRB product specifications will be published after confirmation by KARI.

3. Quality assessment

A quality assessment report for selected KOMPSAT-5 NRB sample products will be provided. The report will document the evaluated samples, assessment methods and results approved for publication by KARI.

4. Data availability

Data distribution arrangements are under internal review at KARI. Access information and any sample-product download links will be published once confirmed.

5. Terms of use

The planned licence for the technical documentation is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

Conditions for access to and use of KOMPSAT-5 NRB data products will be specified separately by KARI. The documentation licence does not establish the data-product terms.
